373	Eden is. In Islam, Muhammad decided he knew what
374	Paradise is,
375	and all the Paradise he speaks of is lusts
376	that are forbidden in this world. He promises them
377	that they will have these there, and some in their great foolishness
378	commit suicide, thinking this is what they will receive
379	there. In Judaism, every person of understanding grasps that Gan Eden
380	is spiritual, not a physical world with the lusts of
381	this world. Even by simple logic one can understand
382	that in the spiritual realm of creation things do not work as
383	in our physical world.
384	The Rambam says: do you know why there is no description
385	in Judaism of exactly what Gan Eden is? It is written that the tzaddikim
386	sit with crowns on their heads, which symbolizes kingship,
387	a kind of liberation from all the material matters of this world,
388	and they enjoy the radiance of the Shechinah. But specify more, what is it
389	like, what kind of pleasure is it? The Rambam says: just as
390	you cannot explain to someone blind from birth what a
391	color is, so you cannot explain to a person who is
392	in this world in a way that he will understand what Gan Eden is.
393	And our Torah is a Torah of truth, so it does not try
394	to fool people, it does not try to deceive you:
395	listen, keep the mitzvot, and in Gan Eden you will eat
396	cakes and have such lusts and such pleasures. That is
397	a lie, it is not true. Therefore our Torah only says:
398	know that "one hour of contentment in the World to Come is better
399	than all the life of this
400	world." And tzaddikim sit with crowns on their heads and enjoy
401	the radiance of the Shechinah. The more a person in this world breaks
402	his middot, knowing it is hard for him, he feels like getting angry and
403	doesn't get angry, he takes care to have peace in the home between him and
404	his wife, even though in his opinion she was in the wrong this time,
405	but he controls himself, overcomes, speaks
406	calmly. Not that he has to make himself, nor that a woman
407	should make herself a doormat, no, that is not the intent.
408	A person must protect his needs, what
409	he requires, but everything in ways of pleasantness, solving
410	the problem out of closeness, out of friendship, out of love.
411	And there are solutions. King Shlomo said: "Death and life are in the power of
412	the tongue." With the mouth a person can correctly build
413	the marital relationship well, can create a pleasant
414	atmosphere around him. Every person can test
415	himself: when he arrives at a hall
416	for a celebration and there are tables, he looks for a free place. All the
417	tables have free places, and there are places
418	where people are already sitting.
419	Usually, when he sees friends at different
420	tables, at which table does he choose to go
421	and sit?
422	At the table where the people sitting there are
423	people who are fun to talk to, people it is pleasant
424	to be in the company of. And what determines whether it is pleasant or not? "Death
425	and life are in the power of the tongue." With the mouth a person can cause
426	himself to be beloved in society, desired in society. With the mouth he
427	can cause himself to be pushed away and ostracized by everyone, and no
428	one likes to be in contact with him, they only run away
429	from him. Working on the middot makes a person gain
430	a higher spiritual personality in terms of eternal life,
431	coming to the World of Truth with a built, stable soul, and also
432	in this world he gains a good life in what is
433	between him and his fellow, in marriage, in raising children. Also
434	raising children: children who see an example of parents
435	who speak pleasantly, calmly, respectfully, with derech eretz,
436	those children go out into life and they too have shalom
437	bayit. Children who see in their parents tension
438	and anger and quarrels, how will they go out into life
439	if this is the example they saw, that this is how a man and woman live?
440	No matter how much they try to change, it will be very hard for them.
441	They need to take courses and guidance. It is not impossible, it can
442	be fixed, yes, but the work is very, very hard,
443	because it is human nature to copy from the skin the patterns of
444	behavior he saw in them. This is also something that must give great strength
445	to parents: while the children are at home and there is some
446	reason for the parents to quarrel, when the children are present,
447	the parents must draw tremendous strength and know: we
448	do not sink to this level of disrespectful speech, we do not
449	sink to this level of tensions and anger. Why? Because
450	there is a child here. We said once what this is like: when there are
451	children in the house,

453	event, and he sees the abundance of food and delicacies
